The '''shoal unitusk''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of medium-sized [[Fish/Legends|fish]] present in [[Blba Groves]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. It could be recognised by the single horn on its head.<ref name="Item" />
